plugin.name: Minecraft AI Bridge
plugin.description: Bridges Minecraft (Forge 1.20.1 client mod) into MaiBot: in-game chat and events are reported to MaiBot for reasoning, and MaiBot's decisions are sent back as real in-game actions.
gateway.name: Minecraft client gateway
gateway.description: Receives in-game chat and delivers MaiBot replies into the game
tool.mc_state: Inspect the Minecraft character's full current state
tool.mc_query: Review what recently happened in the game
tool.mc_scan_blocks: Search for blocks near the character
tool.mc_scan_entities: List creatures and players near the character
tool.mc_inventory: Show the character's inventory and equipment
tool.mc_chat: Make the character say something in game chat
tool.mc_command: Make the character run a Minecraft command
tool.mc_follow: Make the character follow a player or mob
tool.mc_stop: Immediately stop everything the character is doing
tool.mc_task_status: Show what the character is currently doing
tool.mc_mine: Break the block at the given coordinates
tool.mc_mine_blocks: Find and mine several blocks of a given type
tool.mc_place: Place the held block at the given coordinates
tool.mc_craft: Craft an item (finds the recipe, checks materials, takes the output)
tool.mc_bucket: Fill or empty a bucket (needed for obsidian)
tool.mc_baritone: Drive Baritone: goto / mine / explore / tunnel / build
tool.mc_smelt: Smelt in a furnace (ore into ingots, sand into glass)
tool.mc_recipes: Look up crafting recipes, ingredients and whether you have them
tool.mc_script: Task group: hand a whole multi-step routine to the game at once
tool.mc_defend: Defend: assess the situation and clear nearby hostiles (eat or back off when low)
tool.mc_takeover: AI takeover: release the mouse and keep the world running while the AI plays
tool.mc_shoot: Fire any ranged weapon: bow, crossbow, trident or gun. Ammo is checked first.
tool.mc_look_at: Make the character look at a target
tool.mc_sleep: Find a nearby bed and sleep
command.mc_say: Make the in-game character say something
command.mc_exec: Make the in-game character run a command
command.mc_stop: Stop everything the in-game character is doing
homecard.title: Minecraft Bridge
homecard.content: Bridges Minecraft (Forge 1.20.1 mod) into MaiBot: in-game chat reaches MaiBot, and MaiBot's actions really happen in the game.
error.not_running: The Minecraft bridge plugin is not running (the WebSocket server failed to start; check for a port conflict).
error.no_client: No Minecraft client is connected. Make sure the game is running, the mod is loaded, and serverUrl in config/mcai_bridge-client.toml points at this plugin's WebSocket address.
